participant_1.name: Alex
participant_1.personality: Curious and friendly, Alex enjoys engaging in deep conversations and values community service.
participant_1.background: I volunteer my time with a local bunny rescue. My favorite color is navy blue. I work full-time in a shipyard. I donate a part of my salary to charity each month.

participant_2.name: Amina
participant_2.personality: Resilient and passionate, Amina embraces her culture and loves to share her experiences with others.
participant_2.background: Now I live in the United States. My aunt helped me escape when I was a teenager. I was born in Somalia. I was forced to marry when I was young. I like to dance.
